series.title: The Flatshare
series.description: After a breakup leaves Tiffany needing somewhere cheap to live, she agrees to share a London flat and even the same bed with hospice nurse Leon on opposite schedules. They begin as strangers communicating through notes, but separate lives, difficult relationships and Leon's imprisoned brother steadily pull them toward one another.

series.title: The Kids Are Alright
series.description: In early-1970s Los Angeles, Mike and Peggy Cleary raise eight sons in a crowded Irish-Catholic household where thrift, faith and parental authority are constantly tested by the boys' schemes, rivalries and very different ideas about the lives they want.

series.title: The Librarians
series.description: A hidden Library protects the world from magical artifacts and legends that are far more real than ordinary history admits. Flynn Carsen and successive teams of Librarians and Guardians travel wherever dangerous magic escapes containment, solving impossible mysteries while the Library itself repeatedly becomes part of the problem.
series.collectionScope: Season 01 begins with The Librarian: Quest for the Spear (2004) as E00, followed by The Librarians Season 01. Seasons 02–04 continue The Librarians, while Seasons 05–06 continue the chronology with The Librarians: The Next Chapter Seasons 01–02 (2025–2026).
